# Laravel Excel fixtures

These small spreadsheets are copied unchanged from the Laravel Excel project's test suite
(`tests/Data/Disks/Local/`). They are MIT-licensed, Copyright (c) Spartner; see `LICENSE` in this folder.

They are used as **parity fixtures**: real files authored by Microsoft Excel (macOS and Windows),
LibreOffice and ONLYOFFICE, mostly with shared strings. `rusty_sheet` must read them exactly as
OpenSpout does.
